newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hochtief shares lead gainers pre-bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hochtief shares lead gainers pre-bourse.

text.p: Shares in German builder Hochtief AG were the top gainers in pre-bourse electronic trade on Tuesday, lifted by an announcement that it and Deutsche Bank would announce details of a share pool in Philipp Holzmann, Germany's largest builder. at 1100 GMT.
Shares in Hochtief were up 2.60 marks, or 3.64 percent, at 74 marks in pre-bourse IBIS trade, while the overall IBIS DAX index was up 27.78 points, or 0.84 percent, at 3,330.35 points.
Hochtief and Holzmann were expected to announce a deal giving Hochtief increased control over its industry rival, while neatly dodging cartel office objections to a broader tie-up.

The two firms said they would inform the media about plans to pool stakes totalling almost 50 percent held in Holzmann by Deutsche and Hochtief. Deutsche will be co-host at the news conference, the two buildings groups said.
